folds.text: An **AI model** is a program that learned patterns from huge amounts of text. It does not look answers up. It predicts what fits next.
Type "The sky is" and the most likely next word is probably `blue`. Claude does this one small piece at a time, very fast.
Because it predicts rather than looks things up, it can sound sure and still be wrong. That is why checking important answers matters.

folds.question: Complete it: "Peanut butter and ..."
folds.why: Right! The model picks what is most likely, based on patterns it learned.
